messages:
marco (sales): Heads up — Skyline Edge (public sector) asking for Net90 + usage discount. They want Net90, 20% off usage over 200k tokens/month, 3 months of trial credits (~$25k), and a private deployment. Need deal-desk signoff by EOD tomorrow.

tara (finance): Can you share ARR and credit check? Net90 on a new customer + private infra increases risk.

liam (revops): We can do an invoice split to mitigate risk. Suggest 30% upfront to cover infra, then monthly usage invoices.

marco (sales): Customer procurement insists on Net90 because of internal payment cycles. They can provide a PO but want payment terms reflected.

marco (sales): Proposed invoice terms (draft):
```
- Initial invoice (30% of committed + infra fee): due on PO signature
- Monthly usage invoices: net90 from invoice date
- Trial credit: $25,000 applied across first 3 monthly invoices
- SLA uplift fee: waived for year 1
```

tara (finance): Finance can approve conditional Net90 only if we get: 1) copy of the PO that explicitly covers the upfront 30%, and 2) a completed credit form + basic KYC. Also want a fallback (escrow or payment guarantee).

sarah (legal): We'll need a contract amendment for private deployment: add data residency, encryption/KMS clause, and indemnities. Ask customer for legal contact.

liam (revops): I'll draft the split invoice schedule in Zuora and mark as manual collect for the upfront. Will also add a note for billing ops to monitor usage thresholds.

invoice-bot: Draft invoice #INV-2026-342 created for 30% upfront (Amount: $75,000). Status: DRAFT — awaiting approval.

tara (finance): Please attach customer credit form and PO when available. Add late-payment clause: 1.5% monthly after 60 days if outstanding.

marco (sales): @tara noted. I'll push for PO + credit form from procurement today. If we get PO by EOD, can finance provisionally approve Net90?

tara (finance): Provisional yes — contingent on upfront 30% clearing and PO explicitly covering it. Approving deal-desk to proceed with draft. :white_check_mark:

sarah (legal): Legal will prepare the amendment. Need confirmation on hosting region and KMS vendor before finalizing.

liam (revops): Opening a ticket in #billing-ops to attach the schedule and mark the invoices. @invoice-bot, please flag when upfront payment posts.

invoice-bot: Payment tracking enabled. Will notify @tara and @liam on payment events.

marco (sales): Thanks everyone. Looping in the customer's procurement and legal now. Will post PO here when received. :thumbsup:
